articles.title: Haiku R1/beta6 has been released
articles.summary: 如果你在找 Windows/macOS 之外的开源系统，这个 BeOS 系新版本值得看一眼，但主力机别装。
articles.body: After about two years since the last beta, and only about a week after Haiku’s 25th birthday, Haiku R1/beta6 has been released! See “ Release Notes ” for the release notes, “ Press contact ”, for press inquiries … and “ Get Haiku! ” to skip all that and just download the release (or upgrade to it from an existing install.)
articles.bodyZh: 距离上次测试版发布大约两年后，就在Haiku操作系统庆祝25岁生日大约一周之际，Haiku R1/beta6终于正式发布了！想了解详细更新内容，可以去看“版本说明”（Release Notes）；媒体朋友有采访需求，请通过“媒体联系”（Press contact）渠道沟通……当然，你要是等不及了，直接点“获取Haiku！”（Get Haiku!）就能跳过这些，立刻下载新版本（或者从现有安装直接升级到最新版）。

articles.summary: 如果你在做日元相关的外汇内容或打算去日本，这条汇率破位意味着政策博弈还没结束。
articles.body:
Today's print edition

Traders now are carefully watching yen levels for signs of when authorities might move to protect the currency. | REUTERS BLOOMBERG SHARE/SAVE X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link Aug 29, 2026 The yen weakened past the key ¥160-per-dollar level as it extends a slide that’s erased more than half of its intervention-fueled gains.

The Japanese currency slipped as much as 0.5% to ¥160.16 versus the greenback after the dollar got a boost from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh’s vow to hit the central bank’s inflation target. Traders now are carefully watching yen levels for signs of when authorities might move to protect the currency.

The yen has been under pressure since failing to push through ¥155 earlier this month in the wake of joint action on July 31, when the U.S. and Japan conducted their first coordinated yen-buying intervention since 1998. The latest bout of yen weakness emerges even after U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent made a fresh attempt to rein in long-term U.S. borrowing costs from multiyear highs.

articles.title: Blind Men and the Elephant: Probing the Epistemic Myopia of LLMs under Long-Tail Divergent Knowledge
articles.zh: 盲人摸象：探测LLM在长尾分歧知识下的认知短视
articles.summary: 如果你在做事实核查或知识库类产品，这篇提醒你LLM对冷门领域的认知短板比想象中更隐蔽
articles.author: Zhuoshi Pan, Junru Lu 等
articles.body: Factual question answering (QA) typically assumes a single canonical answer, obscuring whether large language models (LLMs) retain divergent accounts of long-tail facts. To address this gap, we introduce ElephantBench, a closed-book knowledge probe comprising 1,094 questions generated through an auditable graph-based pipeline. The pipeline retrieves related documents from a low-exposure web corpus, identifies naturally occurring disagreements, and converts them into multi-account QA records. Each answer is verified against the originating documents and authoritative public web sources and is then reviewed by human annotators. Across 32 models, even the strongest model recovers both accounts on only 52.4% of questions, while on nearly all remaining questions it recalls one account but omits the other. Scaling model size and inference-time reasoning improve recall but do not eliminate this incompleteness. Corpus analysis further shows that exposure imbalance favors the dominant account, whereas greater minority-side exposure is associated with more complete recall. These findings establish ElephantBench as a reproducible knowledge probe for diagnosing epistemic myopia in parametric memory. More broadly, our graph-based benchmark construction pipeline provides an efficient and scalable way to turn long-tail corpora into source-traceable knowledge probes, supporting efforts to evaluate and advance the epistemic rigour of next-generation LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/ElephantBench.
articles.bodyZh: 事实问答（QA）通常默认只有一个标准答案，这就掩盖了一个问题：大语言模型（LLM）到底有没有记住那些冷门知识的多种说法？为了补上这个缺口，我们搞了个 ElephantBench，一个闭卷知识探针，里面有 1,094 道题，全是通过一套可审计的、基于图谱的流程生成的。这个流程会从一个曝光度很低的网页语料库里抓取相关文档，找出里面天然存在的说法分歧，再把它们转成“多说法问答”的记录。每一条答案都要对照原始文档和权威公开网页核实，最后还得过一遍人工审核。我们在 32 个模型上测了，结果最强的模型也只有 52.4% 的问题能同时回忆起两种说法；剩下的大部分问题，它只能记起一种，另一种直接漏掉。把模型做大、推理时多花点心思确实能提高召回率，但解决不了这种“不完整”。语料分析还发现，曝光不均衡会偏向主流说法，而少数说法的曝光越多，完整召回的可能性就越高。这些结果说明，ElephantBench 是一个可复现的知识探针，能用来诊断参数记忆里的“认知近视”。往大了说，我们这套基于图谱的基准构建流程，提供了一种高效、可扩展的办法，能把冷门语料变成有源可查的知识探针，帮大家评估和提升下一代大语言模型的认知严谨性。代码在 https://github.com/Tencent/ElephantBench。

articles.title: ContextPilot: Teaching Agents for Proactive Context Management via Fine-grained RL
articles.zh: ContextPilot：通过细粒度强化学习教Agent主动管理上下文
articles.summary: 如果你在搭Agent应用，上下文越长越乱是痛点，这篇给了个让AI学会主动取舍上下文的训练思路
articles.author: Zhuoshi Pan, Qizhi Pei 等
articles.body: Long-horizon agentic tasks require large language models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve, integrate, and maintain dispersed information across multi-turn interactions, but preserving all interaction histories leads to a continuously growing working context. Recent proactive context management methods allow models to edit their own working context with specialized tools, yet they still face three key limitations: (1) a limited toolset restricted to search, deletion, and summarization, with no support for global planning, long-term memory, and adaptive compression; (2) inefficient exploration that treats context management actions uniformly despite their heterogeneous impacts on final outcomes; and (3) coarse-grained credit assignment that assigns the final trajectory-level reward to all intermediate context editing actions during RL. To bridge these gaps, we introduce ContextPilot, a proactive context management framework for long-horizon agentic reasoning. Our approach systematically augments the toolset with planning, long-term memory, and soft context offloading tools. We further propose an RL method tailored for context management, which uses context and entropy variation to identify critical editing decisions for branch sampling and estimates action-level advantages from all branched trajectories that pass through the corresponding context editing action. Experiments on long-context QA and deep search tasks show that ContextPilot achieves stronger performance with a more compact working context, consistently outperforming existing baselines across various base models and benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/ContextPilot.
articles.bodyZh: 长线智能体任务（long-horizon agentic tasks）往往需要大语言模型（LLM）在多轮交互中不断检索、整合并维持分散的信息，但如果把每一次交互的历史全保留下来，工作上下文就会越攒越长，越走越臃肿。最近有一些主动式上下文管理方法（proactive context management）允许模型用专门的工具来编辑自己的工作上下文，但它们仍卡在三大问题上：一是工具集太窄，只有搜索、删除、总结这几种，不支持全局规划、长期记忆和自适应压缩；二是探索效率低下，所有上下文管理动作都被一视同仁地处理，完全不管这些动作对最终结果的影响差别有多大；三是信用分配太粗糙，在强化学习时把最终轨迹级的奖励一股脑分给中间所有上下文编辑动作，没有精细化区分到底哪一步才是关键。为了补上这些短板，我们提出ContextPilot，一个面向长线智能体推理的主动上下文管理框架。我们的方法系统扩展了工具集，加入规划、长期记忆和软性上下文卸载（soft context offloading）工具。我们还专门设计了一套贴合上下文管理场景的强化学习（RL）方法：利用上下文和信息熵（entropy）的变化来找出哪些编辑决策是关键节点，再做分支采样；同时，不是只看最终奖励，而是从所有经过该上下文编辑动作的分支轨迹中，估算出动作级别的优势值（action-level advantage）。我们在长上下文问答和深度搜索任务上做了实验，结果显示ContextPilot不仅性能更强，而且工作上下文更精简，在不同基座模型和多个基准上都能稳定超过现有基线。代码已开源：https://github.com/Tencent/ContextPilot。

articles.title: COVER: Identifiable Evaluation of Coalition Routing
articles.zh: COVER：联合路由的可识别性评估方法
articles.summary: 如果你在研究网络路由或联邦调度策略，这篇提供了一套能区分不同机制贡献的评估框架
articles.author: Raghul Sugumar, Amrit Gopinath
articles.body: When a multi-agent system changes its team, it also changes the messages and final answer it produces, so an end-to-end accuracy gap does not by itself identify a routing effect. We introduce method, an evaluation contract that fixes a public information boundary, downstream stack G, and finite legal team family before outcomes are generated. Complete coverage identifies exact finite-benchmark oracle regret conditional on that stack. For any finite collection of frozen policies, executing the union of their distinct selected teams is the minimal assumption-free support for every pairwise policy contrast, though not for absolute oracle regret. Two controlled tables with source-ID-disjoint splits test the instrument. On MuSiQue-12, a pre-specified privileged positive control improves regret from 0.532 to 0.402; a later public-interface control reaches 0.424 versus 0.554 but is retrospective. On HotpotQA-4, a pre-specified public direct scorer improves regret from 0.313 to 0.110. In fixed-stack Llama execution, verified route regret improves by 0.190, while the raw-answer gain is 0.010 with an interval crossing zero. A five-family ToolSandbox variant-shift validation exhaustively evaluates 16 declared teams on 14 untouched task variants (224/224 valid rows): the declared-family oracle reaches 0.768 safe-evidence completion, while the prospectively frozen router gets 0.637 (regret 0.131), failing the predeclared 0.10 criterion. A later retrospective comparator reaches 0.655, matching all-workers with 4.57 versus 5.00 workers on average. Thus COVER exposes selection headroom without manufacturing a routing win. A crossed-stack diagnostic shows absolute scores depend on G but finds no detectable router-by-finalizer interaction. COVER is an auditable measurement methodology, not a claim of stack-invariant or universal agent-routing superiority.
articles.bodyZh:
当一个多智能体系统（multi-agent system）更换了它的团队成员，它生成的中间消息和最终答案也会跟着变。所以，光看端到端的准确率差距，并不能直接说明问题出在路由选择上。为此，我们提出了一种叫做COVER的评估方法，它本质上是一份“评估契约”：在结果产生之前，先固定好公共信息边界、下游的固定技术栈G，以及一个有限且合法的团队组合集合。只要覆盖完整，就能精确算出在给定技术栈下的有限基准（benchmark）理想遗憾值（oracle regret，即与理想选择之间的差距）。对于任意一组冻结策略（frozen policies），把各自选出的不同团队合并起来跑一遍，是支持所有两两策略对比的最低无假设要求——但要注意，这不能用来衡量绝对的理想遗憾值。我们用两张受控的表格来验证这个工具，两张表都按来源ID做了互不重叠的数据切分。在MuSiQue-12上，一个事先指定的特权阳性对照组把遗憾值从0.532降到了0.402；后来一个基于公共接口的对照组也达到了0.424对0.554的成绩，但那是事后补做的。在HotpotQA-4上，一个事先指定的公开直接评分器把遗憾值从0.313降到了0.110。在固定技术栈Llama的执行环境下，经过验证的路由遗憾值改善了0.190，而原始答案的增益只有0.010，而且置信区间跨过了零，说明这个提升并不显著。

我们还做了一个包含五个模型族的ToolSandbox变体迁移验证，在14个从未接触过的任务变体上，穷尽评估了16个声明过的团队组合，总共224行数据全部有效。声明族里的理想选择达到了0.768的安全证据完成率，而事前冻结的路由器只有0.637，遗憾值为0.131，没达到事先声明的0.10标准。后来一个事后补测的对照组做到了0.655，在平均工人数上跟全员参与的组持平——4.57对比5.00。这说明COVER能暴露路由选择上的提升空间，但不会人为造出一个“路由胜利”的假象。还有一个跨技术栈的诊断实验显示，绝对分数确实取决于技术栈G，但没有发现路由器与最终执行器之间有什么可检测的交互效应。

总而言之，COVER是一种可审计的测量方法，它不是在宣称什么“换栈不变”或“放之四海而皆准”的智能体路由优越性。

articles.title: Real-time virtual circuits for plasma shape control via neural network emulators: experimental demonstration on MAST Upgrade
articles.zh: 神经网络仿真器驱动的实时虚拟电路等离子体形状控制：MAST Upgrade实验验证
articles.summary: 如果你关注AI在可控核聚变领域的落地，这篇证明了神经网络仿真器可以支撑实时控制回路
articles.author: Nicola C. Amorisco, Kamran Pentland 等
articles.body: Conventional plasma shape control in tokamaks relies on virtual circuits (VCs) that are computed offline from linearisations around a small, tailored number of reference equilibria, and deployed as expertly prepared schedules during the discharge. Here, we report on the first experimental deployment of real-time VCs. We replace pre-set look up tables with VCs updated in real time using surrogates of the plasma response. Both the existing control architecture and the interpretability of VC-based control are retained. Previous work showed that neural network emulators can produce accurate VCs, and validated their performance in closed-loop shape control simulations. Here, we report their first experimental validation on MAST Upgrade (MAST-U). Dedicated experiments spanning different scenarios, including prescribed shape perturbations, feedback-driven divertor-leg motion, and strongly evolving plasma configurations, show that real-time VCs can realise plasma shape control tasks within the MAST-U plasma control system. These results establish the experimental feasibility of real-time linearisations as a practical extension of conventional plasma shape control in tokamaks. The present implementation demonstrates a central step towards a simpler control workflow, in which manually constructed, phased VC schedules are replaced by VCs generated automatically online from a trained surrogate model, without scenario-specific retraining.
articles.bodyZh:
托卡马克装置（tokamak）里，传统的等离子体形状控制靠的是“虚拟回路”（virtual circuits，简称VCs）。这些回路是在离线状态下，围绕少数几个精心挑选的参考平衡态做线性化计算出来的，然后在放电过程中按一套专家预先编排好的时间表来执行。本文要报告的是，我们首次在实验中真正部署了实时虚拟回路。

具体做法是，不再用预先设定好的查找表，而是用等离子体响应的替代模型（surrogate），实时更新虚拟回路。这样既保留了现有的控制架构，也保留了基于虚拟回路控制的可解释性。

之前的研究已经证明，神经网络模拟器可以生成准确的虚拟回路，并且在闭环形状控制仿真中验证了它们的表现。这次我们要汇报的，是它们在MAST升级装置（MAST Upgrade，MAST-U）上的首次实验验证。

我们专门设计了一系列跨越不同场景的实验，包括预设的形状扰动、反馈驱动的偏滤器腿（divertor-leg）运动，以及强演化中的等离子体位形。这些实验结果表明，实时虚拟回路能够在MAST-U的等离子体控制系统中完成形状控制任务。

这些结果证明了实时线性化作为传统托卡马克等离子体形状控制的实用扩展，在实验上是可行的。我们这次的实现，也迈出了走向更简单控制流程的关键一步——不再需要人工精心编排分阶段的虚拟回路时间表，而是靠一个训练好的替代模型，在线自动生成虚拟回路，而且针对不同场景不需要重新训练。

articles.title: Stranger, Fan, or Peer? A Systematic Study on the Role of Interlocutor in Persona-Based Dialogue Generation
articles.zh: 陌生人、粉丝，还是同行？对话对象角色对基于人格对话生成的影响系统研究
articles.summary: 如果你在做角色化聊天机器人，这篇告诉你用户和AI的关系定位会显著改变对话质量和用户预期
articles.author: Daniela Occhipinti, Malvina Nissim 等
articles.body: Persona-based dialogue systems are usually conditioned on speaker biography, but dialogues involve at least two participants, and who has access to whose biography can vary across training, inference, and evaluation. Prior work often neglected these aspects, obscuring mechanisms that only appear when biography visibility is toggled separately across training, inference, and evaluation, a three-stage factorisation that prior work has largely treated as a single factor. We study this factorisation on a dataset of dialogues paired with speaker's biographies, varying whether the target and interlocutor speakers see each other's biographies during training and inference, and using an LLM as a judge to perform author identification. We find that (i) training-time visibility, more than inference-time visibility, determines whether models express persona traits through dialogue or fall back on copying biographical text (a known problem/phenomenon in persona-based generation); (ii) models trained with interlocutor-biography visibility copy less target-biographical text than models trained without it, while changing visibility only at inference time has a less consistent effect; and (iii) under asymmetric disclosure, where only the interlocutor sees the target biography, target content leaks into interlocutor turns more often, and dialogues containing such traces are easier for the judge to identify, especially when interlocutor turns are visible. These results suggest that biography leakage into generated turns is an artefact of how interlocutor visibility is configured across training and inference, and separating the three stages is necessary.
articles.bodyZh: 基于人物设定的对话系统，通常是用说话人的背景资料来做条件控制，但对话至少涉及两个人，而且谁能看到谁的背景资料，在训练、推理和评估阶段都可能不一样。以前的研究常常忽略这些细节，导致一些机制看不出来——只有当你在训练、推理、评估三个阶段分别切换背景资料的可见性时，这些机制才会浮现。但之前的工作基本把这三个阶段混成了一个因素来对待。我们就在一个“对话+说话人背景资料”配对的数据集上研究了这种分解，分别改变目标说话人和对方说话人在训练和推理时能否看到彼此的背景资料，并用一个大语言模型（LLM）当裁判来做作者识别。我们发现：（1）训练阶段的可见性，比推理阶段的可见性，更能决定模型是会在对话中表达人物特质，还是干脆直接抄背景资料里的原文（这是基于人物设定的生成里一个已知问题/现象）；（2）如果训练时让对方说话人能看到目标说话人的背景资料，模型拷贝目标背景原文的情况，比训练时看不到的情况要少；而只在推理阶段改可见性，效果就没那么稳定；（3）在不对称披露的情况下——也就是只有对方能看到目标说话人的背景——目标说话人的内容更容易漏到对方的发言里，而含有这种痕迹的对话，裁判也更容易识别出来，尤其是当对方的发言可见时。这些结果表明，背景资料泄漏到生成的对话里，其实是对方可见性在训练和推理阶段怎么配置造成的一个假象，所以把这三个阶段分开来看是很有必要的。

articles.title: Anatomy-Aware Promptable Segmentation with Online Interactive Training for AUTOPET V
articles.zh: 面向AUTOPET V的解剖感知可提示分割与在线交互训练
articles.summary: 如果你在做医学影像标注工具，这篇把解剖先验知识和在线交互训练结合起来，标注效率可能有提升空间
articles.author: Pablo Lozano-Jimenez, Sergio Romero-Tapiador 等
articles.body: We present an anatomy-aware, promptable model for whole-body lesion segmentation in FDG and PSMA PET/CT, developed for the AUTOPET V challenge. The proposed method is built as family of nnU-Net-based models and trained in two stages: i) a pre-training stage that produces a strong initial segmentation, and ii) an online interactive stage that learns to exploit scribble prompts, refining the prediction over successive interactions. Anatomical context is incorporated through organ supervision using a single shared head that predicts lesions and organs from the same features, which reduces false positives arising from physiological uptake. Also as the tracer (i.e., FDG/PSMA) is not provided at inference, we add a tracer classifier based on image processing and a random forest over coronal MIP features, routing each study to a combined FDG+PSMA model or to a PSMA-specific model. Across four-fold cross-validation the organ-supervised model achieves the best and most stable performance, the interactive stage improves the Dice score monotonically with each prompt, and PSMA-specific training yields the strongest tracer-wise results.
articles.bodyZh:
我们提出了一种解剖感知、可提示的模型，用于FDG和PSMA PET/CT中的全身病灶分割，这是为AUTOPET V挑战赛开发的。这个方法其实是一组基于nnU-Net的模型，分两个阶段训练：第一阶段是预训练，先搞出一个靠谱的初始分割结果；第二阶段是在线交互，模型学着利用涂鸦式的提示，通过一轮轮交互不断修正预测。

我们还把解剖背景信息加了进去，办法是用一个共享的输出头同时预测病灶和器官，这样能从同一套特征里同时认这俩东西，从而减少因为生理性摄取（正常组织也会吸收示踪剂）造成的假阳性。另外，由于推理时不会告诉我们用的是什么示踪剂（也就是FDG还是PSMA），我们加了一个示踪剂分类器，基于图像处理，再加上一个对冠状面MIP特征跑随机森林的分类器，把每个病例分流到FDG+PSMA联合模型，或者专门的PSMA模型。

通过四折交叉验证，器官监督的模型表现最好也最稳定；交互阶段每提示一次，Dice分数就单调往上涨；而专门用PSMA训练的模型在单个示踪剂上的结果最强。

articles.title: Acquire, Repair, Preserve: A Diagnosis-Guided Post-Training Recipe for Small-Model Dialogue Game Agents
articles.zh: 获取、修复、保留：诊断引导的小模型对话游戏Agent后训练方案
articles.summary: 如果你在用小模型做游戏NPC或对话产品，这篇提供了一套先诊断问题再定向修补的后训练流程
articles.author: Nan Li
articles.body: Interactive dialogue games test a capability that static benchmarks largely leave implicit: a model must carry state across turns, interpret feedback, and choose valid actions under changing constraints. We study this setting in the LM Playschool Challenge with a 2B open-weight model, and find that many failures are not only broad knowledge failures but also local decision failures: repeated guesses, malformed actions, and violations of feedback that the model has just seen. These diagnostics motivate a training recipe organized around three steps: acquire broad game participation through supervised fine-tuning, repair mechanically verifiable failures within one targeted dialogue-game family using turn-local preference pairs, and preserve general capabilities beyond these dialogue games. In the official final evaluation, our submission improves public clemscore from 10.67 to 38.92 and closed in-domain score from 13.41 to 41.17, while approximately preserving aggregate static performance (44.14 vs. 44.24 for the baseline). Out-of-domain clemscore remains low at 7.88, with the largest gains concentrated in unseen variants of the targeted family. Our results suggest that broad SFT brings most of the model's capability improvement; turn-local supervision can be effective when failure detection is precise, with observed transfer concentrated primarily within-family.
articles.bodyZh: 互动对话游戏考验的是一种静态基准测试（static benchmarks）大多不会明说的能力：模型得在多轮对话中一直记住当前状态，理解反馈，然后在规则不断变化的时候做出有效动作。我们在LM Playschool挑战赛里，用一个20亿参数（2B）的开放权重（open-weight）模型来研究这个场景，结果发现很多失败不只是知识层面的短板，更多是局部决策出了岔子——比如反复瞎猜、动作格式不对、甚至直接无视了刚看到的反馈。这些诊断结果让我们设计了一套三步训练方案：先用监督微调（supervised fine-tuning，SFT）让模型广泛参与游戏，再用某一目标对话游戏家族里的回合局部偏好对（turn-local preference pairs）去修复那些能机械验证的错误，最后保住模型在这些对话游戏之外的一般能力。在官方最终评估中，我们的方案把公开的clemscore从10.67拉到了38.92，封闭的域内得分从13.41提高到41.17，同时静态综合表现基本没掉（我们44.14，基线44.24）。不过域外clemscore还是只有7.88，最大的提升集中在目标游戏家族没见过的变体上。结果说明，广泛的SFT贡献了模型能力提升的大头；而当错误检测够精准的时候，回合局部监督也能起作用，而且观察到的迁移主要还是集中在这个家族内部。

articles.title: ARC-CT: Anatomy-Routed Contrastive Vision-Language Learning for 3D Chest CT
articles.zh: ARC-CT：解剖路由的对比视觉-语言学习用于3D胸部CT分析
articles.summary: 如果你在做医疗影像多模态模型，这篇用解剖结构来约束对比学习，比单纯全局对齐更适配3D医学数据
articles.author: Huseyin Umut Isik, Mehmet Alp Ozaydin 等
articles.body: Contrastive vision-language learning uses paired chest CT volumes and radiology reports to learn abnormality classifiers without manually annotated labels. However, two characteristics of chest CT challenge conventional global contrastive learning. First, many critical abnormalities are small or anatomically localized, and pooling an en- tire volume into a single embedding may dilute their visual evidence. Second, the standard contrastive objective treats every other scan in a batch as a negative. Because many chest CTs share abnormalities, this objective incorrectly pushes co-positive pairs apart. We propose Anatomy-Routed Contrastive Learning for 3D Chest CT (ARC-CT), a region-aware framework that addresses these limitations using only la- bels extracted from reports by an LLM, with no manual annotations or bounding boxes. ARC-CT combines three components: (1) an Anato- myQFormer localizing evidence via queries constrained by automatically generated organ masks; (2) a label-Jaccard soft InfoNCE objective in- tegrating the standard one-hot target with the label-set overlap of each pair, which reduces false-negative penalties between studies that share clinical findings; and (3) an organ-level alignment loss connecting mask- pooled visual features to organ-specific report text extracted offline with a large language model. ARC-CT achieves a 0.86 mask-free macro AUC across 18 abnormalities using a compact 3D ResNet-18 backbone. Over- all, ARC-CT outperforms both comparable efficient baselines and sev- eral larger transformer models. Our code and weights are available at https://github.com/arc-ct/arc-ct.
articles.bodyZh: 对比视觉-语言学习，就是用成对的胸部CT影像和放射科报告来训练异常分类器，全程都不需要人工标注。不过，胸部CT有两个特点，让传统的全局对比学习不太管用。第一，很多要命的异常要么特别小，要么只长在某个局部解剖位置，要是把整卷CT压成一个嵌入向量，那点视觉线索很容易就被稀释掉了。第二，标准的对比学习目标会把同批次里每一张其他扫描都当成负样本，可实际上很多胸部CT之间是共享异常特征的，这样一来，那些本该互相靠近的阳性配对反而会被硬生生推开。为了解决这两个问题，我们提出了专门用于三维胸部CT的解剖引导对比学习——ARC-CT。这是一个区域感知的框架，只需要用大语言模型（LLM）从报告里抽标签，不需要任何手动标注，也不需要边界框。ARC-CT由三个部分构成：第一，AnatomyQFormer，它靠自动生成的器官掩码来约束查询，从而定位证据；第二，一个叫标签-杰卡德软InfoNCE的损失函数，它把标准的one-hot目标跟每对样本的标签集合重叠度结合在一起，减少那些有共同临床发现的研究被当成负样本的惩罚；第三，一个器官级别的对齐损失，把掩码池化后的视觉特征和离线用大语言模型提取的器官相关报告文本给对应起来。ARC-CT用轻量的3D ResNet-18作骨干，在18种异常上，无掩码宏平均AUC达到0.86。总体来看，ARC-CT不仅超过了同类的轻量级基线模型，还打败了好几个更大的transformer模型。我们的代码和权重都公开在 https://github.com/arc-ct/arc-ct。
